title: A SAM-key domain required for enzymatic activity of the Fun30 nucleosome remodeler.
authors: Karl, Leonhard A; Galanti, Lorenzo; Bantele, Susanne Cs; Metzner, Felix; Safaric, Barbara; Rajappa, Lional; Foster, Benjamin; Pires, Vanessa Borges; Bansal, Priyanka; Chacin, Erika; Basquin, Jerome; Duderstadt, Karl E; Kurat, Christoph F; Bartke, Till; Hopfner, Karl-Peter; Pfander, Boris
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Fun30核小体重塑酶的SAM-key结构域对ATPase活性的调控，涉及蛋白质-核小体（含DNA）互作与AlphaFold2结构预测，但核心是酶活性调控而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法上仅用结构预测与交联质谱，无AI建模或MD模拟，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Fun30 is the prototype of the Fun30-SMARCAD1-ETL subfamily of nucleosome remodelers involved in DNA repair and gene silencing. These proteins appear to act as single-subunit nucleosome remodelers, but their molecular mechanisms are, at this point, poorly understood. Using multiple sequence alignment and structure prediction, we identify an evolutionarily conserved domain that is modeled to contain a SAM-like fold with one long, protruding helix, which we term SAM-key. Deletion of the SAM-key within budding yeast Fun30 leads to a defect in DNA repair and gene silencing similar to that of the fun30Delta mutant. In vitro, Fun30 protein lacking the SAM-key is able to bind nucleosomes but is deficient in DNA-stimulated ATPase activity and nucleosome sliding and eviction. A structural model based on AlphaFold2 prediction and verified by crosslinking-MS indicates an interaction of the long SAM-key helix with protrusion I, a subdomain located between the two ATPase lobes that is critical for control of enzymatic activity. Mutation of the interaction interface phenocopies the domain deletion with a lack of DNA-stimulated ATPase activation and a nucleosome-remodeling defect, thereby confirming a role of the SAM-key helix in regulating ATPase activity. Our data thereby demonstrate a central role of the SAM-key domain in mediating the activation of Fun30 catalytic activity, thus highlighting the importance of allosteric activation for this class of enzymes.
abstract_zh: Fun30是参与DNA修复和基因沉默的核小体重塑因子Fun30-SMARCAD1-ETL亚家族的原型。这些蛋白质似乎作为单亚基核小体重塑因子发挥作用，但其分子机制目前尚不清楚。通过多序列比对和结构预测，我们鉴定了一个进化上保守的结构域，该结构域被建模为包含一个具有一条长突出螺旋的SAM样折叠，我们将其命名为SAM-key。在芽殖酵母Fun30中删除SAM-key会导致DNA修复和基因沉默缺陷，类似于fun30Delta突变体的表型。在体外，缺乏SAM-key的Fun30蛋白能够结合核小体，但在DNA刺激的ATP酶活性以及核小体滑动和驱逐方面存在缺陷。基于AlphaFold2预测并通过交联质谱验证的结构模型表明，长SAM-key螺旋与突起I（位于两个ATP酶叶之间的亚结构域，对酶活性控制至关重要）之间存在相互作用。相互作用界面的突变模拟了结构域缺失的表型，表现为缺乏DNA刺激的ATP酶激活和核小体重塑缺陷，从而确认了SAM-key螺旋在调节ATP酶活性中的作用。因此，我们的数据证明了SAM-key结构域在介导Fun30催化活性激活中的核心作用，突显了变构激活对此类酶的重要性。
